text:
Situation: Voriconazole 50 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 80 tablets (6.3 days), Corvale General holds 342 tablets (21.2 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 78 tablets (26.3 days). All sites use NDC 65862089103 labeled by Aurobindo Pharma Limited, manufactured at FEI 3007373532 in India.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1105823 at that plant ended 2019-09-27 and was classified OAI, known to FDA on 2019-12-26. A later inspection 1169446 ended 2022-05-10 and was classified VAI, known to FDA on 2022-08-04.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The risk is local to Corvale East. Internal redistribution can resolve the gap without new purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 36 tablets of 50 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. If additional supply is needed, transfer 99 tablets of 50 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).

Not recommended: Purchasing from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., AvPAK, or Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA at this time.
